[[File:Brian Muller FreedomCon 2001.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Brian Muller at FreedomCon 2001.]]
'''Brian Muller''' won the Jedi Knights championship at [[FreedomCon]] in November 2001.<ref name="fc-home">[http://decktech.net/freedomcon/ FreedomCon home page], decktech.net (after the event). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011201221615/http://decktech.net/freedomcon/ Internet Archive, 1 December 2001]</ref> He finished 3rd in the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game|Jedi Knights TCG]] World Championship at [[DecipherCon 2002]] and won $150.<ref name="pc-nov02">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/november02archives.htm November Updates], swccgpc.com (3 November 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221953/http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/november02archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 24th at the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] Day 2 (9 (−6)).<ref name="d2">[https://web.archive.org/web/20001026043505/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/results/starwars.html DecipherCon 2000 Day 2]</ref>
